name: Bremen City Hall
scope: Whole surviving physically attached Bremen Old and New Town Hall: complete old hall and hipped dark roof, eleven open market arcade bays, upper hall tall mullioned windows, eight coarse attached Gothic figures, projecting two-storey central oriel, large central and two smaller sculpted Renaissance gables/balustrades/finials; old hall end walls/pointed windows/entrances; full offset New Town Hall with native L-shaped wings and genuine inner courtyard, copper hipped roof/dormers/open roof lantern, north rounded projecting oriel/pediment, western repeated crossgables/rounded onion-roof stair turret/low connector. Exclude separate Roland, Town Musicians, detached herald statues, churches/cathedral, parliament, whole square/streets/paving/natural ground and underground Ratskeller interior.
